name: Longer Ray5 5W
tagline: 5W Compact fixed-focus diode : simple desk engraver for small projects
tldr: Longer Ray5 5W is the 5W SKU on the Longer longer ray5 line. Longer's compact Ray5 20W diode engraver : verify you are buying the 20W SKU, not the 5W, 10W, or 40W Ray5 listings. Verify optical power on the listing : do not assume combined-watt marketing.

priceRange.note: 5W optical module : verify SKU before buying

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: 5W on Longer Ray5: engraving-first : photo fills and leather at moderate speeds
Open-frame : plan laser glasses, exhaust, and workspace rules from day one
Software on the profile : trial your workflow on scrap before production
cons: Clear cast acrylic and thick production cutting still favor CO₂, not diode power alone
Confirm optical wattage on the listing before you buy
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 5W SKU on Longer Ray5. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Optimize for engraving: lower DPI on photos, higher scan speed on line art after test burns. Air assist still helps clarity. Compare benchmark times on the next tier before assuming you need more power.
primaryUse: Engraving-first desktop diode for makers who prioritize mark quality over cut speed
mainObjective: Detailed engraving on organics and coated metal : occasional thin cuts only

editorialDepth.advantages: Longer Ray5 5W suits makers who sell marks, photos, and gifts more than daily panel cutting. Reasonable open-frame entry price.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip if you already quote 3 mm+ cutting in production : see 10W, 20W or 40W in the line. Not for cast acrylic or bare metal without spray.
